lines.en: Phoebe, Monica, I'm breaking up with you.
What?
I'm breaking up with you.
You're fired.
Why?
I'm sorry.
I'm just not ready for a relationship right now.
And I'm sorry, too, but I like things done a certain way.
And the chemistry is just not right.
Oh, that's good.
The chemistry thing for us, too.
Wow.
Um, OK.
I realize I came on a little strong,
but it's only because I think you're so amazing.
And I just want to tell you how much I appreciate you
giving me an opportunity here, because you're
the most talented chef I've ever worked for.
anyway.
Tim, wait.
Yeah?
Um, I think I spoke too quickly.
There's a learning curve with this job,
and maybe we could try it again.
Really?
Yeah.
Thank you so much, because I know I can be better.
OK.
And, Tim, I just want to say good luck here.
I'll see you later.
